label.description:
Accessible name for the tablist. Always provide one when multiple tab
groups may appear in a view. When NOT to use: do not use `label` as a
visible heading; render visible context in surrounding content.

--ki-tabs-divider-color.description: color used by the tabs component for divider color.

--ki-tabs-divider-width.description: dimension used by the tabs component for the tablist divider width (the Tab_nav bar has no stroke; the hook stays for consumers to opt back in — material3 keeps its hairline via its override).

--ki-tabs-gap.description: dimension used by the tabs component for gap (MarsUI md bar item gap Space/8xl 26px; the gap carries all spacing now that items have zero inline padding).

--ki-typography-family-body.description: semantic font family for typography family body.

component.description: A tab group for switching between peer content views.

ki-change.description:
Fired once after a user-driven selection change from pointer or keyboard
navigation. `detail.value` is the resolved selected value and `value` is
already current when listeners run. Programmatic `value` writes and
first-render fallback are silent.

tablist.description: Internal row around the tab strip: gap, alignment and the divider. The strip inside it carries the `tablist` role.

groups may appear in a view. When NOT to use: do not use `label` as a

slots.description:
`ki-tab` and `ki-tab-panel` children. Tabs are auto-assigned to an
internal named slot as managed output.
